items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Doc Cheatham and Fats Thomas came by and said, you know, he was serious.

ctx.x: I was playing back in the Hippodrome Theater.
Doc Cheatham and Fats Thomas came by and said, you know, he was serious.

So I went down. And those days, I told you before, it was segregation in Baltimore. And when I went backstage to -- the guy backstage said, what do you want? I said, I'd like to see Mr. Calloway, I have an appointment. He said, well, he's going on stage now and you'll have to come back.
